title: verdict.json
description: Binding verdict from /council-review or /council-verdict. Lives at threads/<thread-id>/verdict.json. See skills/council-review/SKILL.md §Step 9.

verdict.description: Binding verdict types. FIX/ACCEPT/ESCALATE/INVESTIGATE per spec §5.5. TRIAGE_ACCEPT/TRIAGE_REJECT from rules/triage-gate.md (ADOPT-002) — control transition out of status=triage. OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER from rules/single-owner-accountability.md (ADOPT-001) — sole mechanism for owner_alias change.

ownership_transfer.description: Required when verdict=OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER. Per rules/single-owner-accountability.md — issuer MUST be current channel owner_alias; both from_alias and to_alias MUST be active channel members.

triage_decision.description: Required when verdict=TRIAGE_ACCEPT or TRIAGE_REJECT. Per rules/triage-gate.md — captures the triage rationale and, for acceptance, the confirmed acceptance_criteria + effort_estimate_hours.

rationale.description: Why the verdict was issued; required for manual and auto modes alike.

severity.description: OBSERVATION = demoted finding without file:line evidence (see wiki/patterns/evidence-beats-assertion.md).

evidence.description: file:line reference or quoted section. Empty/null triggers demotion to OBSERVATION.

escalate_trigger.description: When verdict=ESCALATE, which mechanical trigger fired (per skills/council-review §ESCALATE triggers).

prior_verdict_archive.description: When this verdict overrides a prior one, relative path to the archived prior verdict.json.

override_count.description: Bounded iteration cap: max 3 overrides per thread (see skills/council-verdict/tests.md T2-16).
